name: Encrypted Sigil
summary: In Shadowglen, the Encrypted Sigil calls newly awakened night elf rogues to Frahun Shadewhisper. He begins their training as dangers gather around Teldrassil.

sections.title: A Hidden Summons
sections.body: New night elf scouts and infiltrators in Shadowglen receive the Encrypted Sigil by discreet means. A quiet messenger brings it on behalf of Frahun Shadewhisper. Its hidden instructions direct each initiate to report to Frahun near Aldrassil. By reading and delivering the token, an initiate shows they can follow subtle directions and carry covert messages.

sections.title: Eyes in the Shadows
sections.body: Frahun explains why rogues matter in an unsettled world. Tensions simmer between the night elves and the distant Horde, yet open warfare is not their only danger. Rogues must gather intelligence across Teldrassil as the Kaldorei’s unseen eyes and blades. They must learn to strike before threats take root in the World Tree’s boughs.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Encrypted Sigil?
aliases: why do i have encrypted sigil
faq.answer: The Encrypted Sigil summons novice night elf rogues to begin training. Its hidden instructions direct you to report to Frahun Shadewhisper near Aldrassil.
Frahun Shadewhisper sends the Encrypted Sigil. He trains rogues in Shadowglen beneath Aldrassil’s boughs.

faq.q: What does Frahun Shadewhisper want with me?
faq.answer: Frahun wants to judge your readiness and teach you about dangers facing the night elves, including possible discord stirred by the Horde. He also gives you basic combat instruction.

faq.q: Where should I take the sigil once I read it?
faq.answer: Take the sigil to Frahun Shadewhisper near Aldrassil in Shadowglen.

angles.text: As a rogue, you begin your path by following the sigil’s hidden instructions and meeting your mentor.
As a night elf, you know covert operatives gather vital intelligence while the Kaldorei face new encroachment from the Horde. This is a fragile era.
